title: Abelian pro-etale closed direct image preserves filtered colimits
statement: For a closed immersion i:Z to X of schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-closed-immersion], with X quasi-compact and quasi-separated [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], the concrete abelian direct-image functor on the small pro-etale sites [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image] preserves colimits of every small filtered diagram shape [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit, def-weil-size-convention].

source.place: Tag 0738 (4) and Tag 098D; abelian geometric part of parent proof step 5.

proof.text: The sections clause of proetale_qcqs_fp_section_calculus, applied to the identity object of any qcqs scheme T, makes the abelian-group colimit comparison bijective. ConcreteCategory.isIso_iff_bijective and preservesColimit_of_isIso_post therefore give preservation of filtered colimits by abelian global sections on T.

For a qcqs pro-etale object W over a scheme Y, use the concrete composition functor MorphismProperty.Over.map along W.hom. The proved source instances ProEt.isContinuous_overMap and ProEt.isCocontinuous_overMap make its restriction on sheaves a left adjoint via Functor.sheafAdjunctionCocontinuous, hence colimit preserving. The image of the identity object of W.left is canonically isomorphic to W by the identity on its underlying scheme. Applying each sheaf to this isomorphism gives a natural isomorphism between evaluation at W and restriction followed by global sections on W.left. The preceding step proves that evaluation at W preserves the given filtered colimits. These are explicit proved private helpers in the item module; no existentially chosen localization equivalence or module/ring comparison is needed.

Let R be restriction to AffineProEt X and let T be R followed by the inclusion into affine presheaves. The source affine-basis comparison makes R an equivalence, so T reflects isomorphisms. Every affine object is qcqs; step 2 and pointwise colimits show that T preserves the filtered colimits. Since these colimits exist, reflectsColimitsOfShape_of_reflectsIsomorphisms implies that T reflects them as well.

The composite of the given direct image with T is evaluated at an affine basis object V by evaluation on the closed fibre V_Z. Its projection to V is a closed immersion and hence affine, so V_Z is affine and in particular qcqs. Step 2 shows that each such evaluation preserves the filtered colimits. Pointwise colimits give preservation by the composite. Finally preservesColimitsOfShape_of_reflects_of_preserves reflects that preservation through T and proves the stated direct-image assertion. The comparison maps throughout are the canonical ones from the colimit universal property. Empty schemes and arbitrary small filtered categories are included; neither compactness nor quasi-separatedness of the ambient base is needed in this argument.
